description: This file defines the 'Authorize' controller class within the OpenCart admin system. It manages the authorization process for administrators, including generating tokens, handling redirects, sending authorization codes via email, and resetting or confirming authorization. The class facilitates multi-step security checks and user authentication workflows specific to admin login sessions.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class for handling administrator authorization, including token management, verification, and security workflows within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle the authorization page display, token creation, and redirection logic.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles the process of resending authorization codes via email, with security checks for existing tokens.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the submitted authorization code, updates authorization status, and manages redirection upon success or failure.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Displays the authorization reset view when a user exceeds allowed attempts; resets authorization tokens.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms authorization, generates reset tokens, and links them to the user.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Handles the process of unlocking access via email and code, resetting authorization tokens, and logging out the user.
